summary: MARS - THE SAMPLE RETURN is a proposed mission to return samples from the surface of Mars to Earth. The mission would use robotic systems and a Mars ascent rocket to collect and send samples of Martian rocks, soils and atmosphere to Earth for detailed chemical and physical analysis. The mission is being planned jointly with NASA and European Space Agency. A game is developed to showcase the historic journey of "MARS SAMPLE RETURN" for which a brief script is mentioned as under: In the year 2050, humanity has successfully established colonies on Mars. Against this backdrop, Piku, a state-of-the-art humanoid robot, is launched from Earth aboard a Starship to undertake one of NASA’s most ambitious projects: the Mars Sample Return Mission. Upon landing, Piku will explore the Martian surface, collect carefully selected geological samples, secure them aboard the Starship, and finally initiate the launch sequence to send the rocket back to Earth with Martian samples. “By successfully returning Martian samples to Earth, Piku will fulfill NASA’s ambitious project and establish a historic milestone in human–robot collaboration.” The game not only showcases the upcoming journey of the Mars Sample Return Mission but also demonstrates the architectural and functional aspects of a Martian space habitat.
details:
To address the challenge “ Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map”, I conceptualized and developed an interactive, game-based visual tool that enables users to design and explore the shape, volume, and layout possibilities of a space habitat on Mars. This educational game aims to inspire and engage the younger generation by combining fun with learning about NASA’s historic and future missions, including the Mars Sample Return initiative.

It is equipped with critical operational modules such as waste management, thermal control, life support, communication systems, power distribution, stowage, and food storage and preparation.

1) A Nuclear Reactor on Martian surface to deal with Power requirements.

2) An advance Radar on Martian surface to engage communications with Earth.

3) A Waste and Garbage collecting plant to recycle the bio-waste which will be further used in Plant growing facilities at Bio-Domes on Martian surface.

4) Bio - Domes on Martian surface will grow the plants in controlled environment and is an essential life support module for onboarded astronauts on MARS.5) These space habitats equipped with essential life support will be a resting place for astronauts on MARS.6) Hydro Plant on MARS remains to be an essential life support for astronauts out there.The project aims to promote learning through fun and engagement. Within the game, a virtual Mars Gallery displays infographics on Martian facts. Players can explore these exhibits. A best way to learn about MARS whilst exploring MARS within the game.

Mars Museum displays the 3D models of machines those who all will be highly instrumental to complete the MARS SAMPLE RETURN mission. Users may navigate close to the 3D models for more information about the specified instruments and machines. Martian Terrain offers an immersive experience, allowing users and players to explore the diverse topography of the Red Planet. They can witness NASA’s Perseverance Rover in action as it collects samples and communicates with Ingenuity—the first helicopter ever to fly on Mars—bringing the Martian surface to life like never before.MSR Final Objective: A glimpse of Piku completing the mission's final objective by sending the Martian samples back on earth followed by a launch sequence performed from Mission Control Centre. Feel the thrill by pressing Launch tab from Rocket console, which will trigger the Starship back to earth with Martian samples.
